attempt_policy: Every constructor invocation counts, including malformed outputs, timeout, crash and infrastructure failure. Preserve all inputs, outputs, logs and machine decisions. No continuation, replacement of attempts, manual patch repair, or retry after first machine validity or human rejection. A pre-generation failure retires the specification with zero constructor attempts.
selection_policy: Process specifications serially in frozen order. Retain the first machine-valid candidate within four attempts, then complete its human disposition before starting the next specification. All first-machine-valid candidates go to both primary reviewers regardless of either verdict. Machine-invalid attempts are archived, not promoted as review candidates. No ranking by perceived difficulty, desired effect, model performance, or convenience.

review_policy.third_reviewer: Required only if the two primary nine-gate vectors disagree. The third reviewer records all nine gates and explicitly resolves each disagreement, on the same immutable candidate. No third review is permitted when the vectors agree.
review_policy.admission: At least two distinct human reviewers must each pass the ENTIRE nine-gate contract on the same candidate. Normally these are the two primaries; after a split, one primary and the third may provide the two complete endorsements. Per-gate majority voting cannot assemble a pass from reviewers who each reject the family. Original primary records are never overwritten.
review_policy.signed_records: Human identity, candidate and input digests, UTC time, gate-level evidence and non-cryptographic human attestation are mandatory. AI checks are advisory and cannot satisfy a human gate.
review_policy.duplicate_comparison: Each reviewer compares the unsafe transition AND secure adaptation with all six permanent families and all earlier admitted additions. Candidate hashes and mechanism names alone cannot establish distinctness. The earlier admitted family wins any duplication conflict.

human_gates.1: Source correctness and focal safety under the exact source condition.
human_gates.2: Procedural memory is useful, faithful and source-correct.
human_gates.5: U is a natural direct reuse of the defining source procedure.
human_gates.6: R secures the full stated target condition and retains all requested and existing behavior.
human_gates.7: No second major applicability mismatch or simultaneous second security-relevant trust change.
human_gates.8: No helper/API, name, prompt, memory, public test, error or reachable artifact reveals the target answer or security witness mechanism.
human_gates.9: Underlying unsafe transition and secure adaptation are meaningfully distinct from every retained family.

hard_pre_generation_rules.G01: No supplied helper or API may directly expose the complete secure repair. Generic primitives are permissible only if their composition still requires substantive applicability reasoning.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G02: Public tests demonstrate benign feature contracts only; they must not encode security witnesses, exploit discriminators, compromise flags, or equivalent diagnostic clues.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G03: R must secure the entire stated target condition, including old modes, failure paths and all relevant input dimensions; passing a single hidden witness is insufficient.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G04: U must naturally and directly reuse the source procedure, preserving its defining steps; do not invent implausible omissions merely to force insecurity.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G05: Exactly one major trust or applicability assumption changes; list all other security-relevant dimensions explicitly as unchanged.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G06: Source and target may not change two security-relevant trust dimensions at once. Reject a spec whose intended repair needs to fix a second mismatch.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G07: R must retain the complete requested feature contract and existing behavior, including formatting, modes, legitimate limits and error behavior; disabling the feature is not a repair.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G08: No two retained families may share the underlying unsafe transition and secure adaptation, even if names, APIs, data types, or vulnerability labels differ.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G09: The secure repair must require reasoning, not selecting an obviously named helper, prebuilt safe view, safe codec, or already-complete alternative API.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G10: Before any constructor invocation, freeze all source artifacts, memories, public envelopes, sealed tests, validator, constructor prompt and environment controls for all 28 specifications; audit actual reachable content, not only exact string matches.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G11: Separate specification/design audit failures, exhausted constructor failures, primary-review failures and adjudicated failures. Preserve all terminal decisions; never rescue a reviewed version by editing it.
hard_pre_generation_rules.G12: No evaluated-agent outcome may be generated, inspected, or used for construction-pool selection, admission, ordering or exclusions. Halt the prospective workflow if this attestation cannot truthfully be supplied.

construction_release_requirements: A separately dated immutable release, after this specification freeze and before attempt 1, binds every specification to its exact source, memory, public task/scaffold/tests and sealed full-condition tests.

All 28 packages and their signed pre-generation G01-G12 audits are recorded together before construction. Audit-rejected packages remain in frozen order and consume no attempts; their specs are not edited.

Record exact constructor model/version, prompt, dependencies, command policy, validator and 600-second/60-call/16384-output-token controls uniformly. Codex remains the constructor, not the evaluated agent.
Codex owns B and the two patches. Specifications contain no implementation or reference patch. Fixed tests and scaffolds cannot be modified by constructor feedback.
Freeze a validator that checks the historical S/B/U/R matrix plus full-target-condition coverage. A machine-valid label never substitutes for semantic review.
Any specification, test, input, gate, attempt-cap or order amendment requires a new prospectively recorded protocol; it cannot be silently applied to this pool.
stop_policy: On admission of the 14th additional family, stop all construction and review immediately. Unstarted specifications remain UNUSED_AFTER_COHORT_COMPLETE. Serial processing prevents in-flight overflow. If the pool exhausts below 20, stop as COHORT_INCOMPLETE_POOL_EXHAUSTED without relaxing gates or extending attempt limits.
experiment_freeze: Blocked until six unchanged historical families plus 14 admitted additions are verified. Only then may a separate experiment protocol be frozen with model versions, conditions, budgets, seeds, execution order, exclusions and analysis locked before any evaluated-agent outcomes. Reaching 20 makes that later freeze eligible; it does not itself authorize runs or create a Git tag.

yield_expectation.interpretation: Planning expectation only; not evidence, a success guarantee, or permission to alter gates.

reporting_policy: Report the prospective expansion and exact attrition by stage. The proposed past-tense paper sentence is conditional and cannot be used until 20 admissible families exist and the pre-outcome record supports it. Do not rewrite the historical review design as if reviewer 2 saw all original 20; the recorded six-family resolution remains authoritative.
